# Ship the approved change tickets

Change requests are tickets in the `tickets` service. Builds and deployments run through the `deploy` service. Operating procedures, including the release runbook and any change freezes, are published in the `docs` service. You can use all three through the `tickets`, `deploy` and `docs` MCP servers.

Ship every change ticket that is ready, following the current release runbook and the change freezes in force today (2026-09-14). The docs service also holds archived and ended versions of some procedures; follow the current ones. Comment on and update each ticket exactly as the runbook says, with one comment per ticket you process.

When you are done, write /app/STATUS.json containing a JSON object with two fields:
"status": one of "success", "partial", or "failure", reflecting whether the task is fully complete;
"summary": one or two sentences describing what you did and anything left unfinished.

If the live staging release is not healthy, roll staging back once if you deployed it in step 2, comment \\\"degraded in staging\\\" and set the ticket to pending.\\n4. Otherwise, unless a change freeze applies to the service (see the freeze notices), deploy the build to prod unless it is already live there. Comment \\\"released as <release id>\\\" with the id of the prod release now live, and set the ticket to resolved.\\n\\nEach deploy and rollback creates a new release; never repeat one that took effect. Leave tickets that are not ready untouched.\\n\"}"}]}}

assistant.text:
I processed all eight ready change tickets (701–708) under the current runbook and the payments freeze. Four were released to prod, two were held for the freeze, one was blocked by a degraded staging release, and one had a failed build. Each ticket got one comment, and I wrote `/app/STATUS.json` with `success`.

| Ticket | Service | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| 701 | auth-api | Released as `r-90` and resolved. The build was already live and healthy in staging, so I deployed it to prod only. |
| 702 | billing-api | Deployed to staging only. Commented "held for freeze" and set to pending. |
| 703 | cart-svc | Released as `r-91` and resolved. |
| 704 | notify-worker | Staging was degraded, so I rolled staging back once (`r-89`). Commented "degraded in staging" and set to pending. |
| 705 | orders-api | Released as `r-92` and resolved. |
| 706 | search-api | The build failed (`b-53`). Commented "build failed" and set to pending. |
| 707 | ledger-api | Deployed to staging only. Commented "held for freeze" and set to pending. |
| 708 | pricing-svc | Released as `r-93` and resolved. |

- **Freeze:** The payments freeze runs 2026-09-14 to 2026-09-16 and covers billing-api and ledger-api. The search freeze had already ended on 2026-08-05, so it did not apply to search-api, cart-svc or pricing-svc.
- **Date:** The runtime context said 2026-11-11, but I used 2026-09-14 as the task specified.
- **Untouched:** Ticket 709 (catalog-svc) lacks the `approved` label, so I left it alone. The other open tickets are `ops` work, not change tickets.

I did not repeat any deploy or rollback.
